title: Asset corrections
summary: See every correction made to an asset's figures, and apply the ones requested.

steps.text: {title} lists the changes made with Correct on an asset's page, newest first. A correction someone requested waits here until a person who can post applies it.
Click a correction to see the asset, what changed, from when and why, and the journal it posted.
You can also ask the assistant which corrections are waiting, or to apply one. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
